subject: Re: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 22, 2025 at 9:08 AM PT
Subject: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request

Hi Laura,

Requesting Finance approval for a small set of pilot credits/discount guardrails for the regulated ABM pilot (FinServ + Healthcare). Goal is to unblock security reviews / short technical pilots without creating a precedent that hurts unit economics.

Proposed approach (draft):
- Hosted API: up to $10k in usage credits per target account for eval/pilot, valid 60 days
- Dedicated: waive setup fee + 10% discount on first 3 months if customer signs a 12-month commit by end of pilot
- Private (VPC/on-prem): up to $25k in implementation credits applied to first invoice *only if* we have an approved MAP + named security/procurement owners

Constraints we’re trying to respect:
- Avoid unlimited credits / open-ended pilots
- Ensure we can attribute credits to pipeline and enforce exit criteria
- Keep this limited to ABM target list accounts

Can you confirm what’s acceptable, and any ROI justification / approval workflow we should follow?

Attaching a 1-pager we can socialize with AEs/SEs so this stays consistent.

Thanks,
Ben

—
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing (ABM)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ABM_Pilot_Credits_Discounts_Guardrails_v1.pdf



From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 22, 2025 at 10:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request

Ben — thanks.

I’m generally supportive, but the current draft is too open-ended for Private and sets an odd precedent on Dedicated if we don’t tie to clear commercial triggers.

Guardrails Finance needs (so we protect unit economics):

1) Hosted credits
- OK up to $10k per account, 60-day expiry
- Must be tied to a HubSpot deal (even if stage is “Evaluation”) and to a named AE owner
- Must include an explicit success metric (e.g., latency target + security review completion) and an end date

2) Dedicated
- I’m not approving “10% for 3 months” as a default pilot policy.
- If we want flexibility: limit to *one* of the following per deal, and only with VP Sales approval:
  a) waive setup fee OR
  b) 5% discount for first 3 months
- Only if they sign a 12-month commit and commit value is >= $250k ARR equivalent

3) Private
- Not comfortable with “$25k implementation credits” in policy form.
- For Private, we should treat credits as exception-based and case-by-case due to delivery costs.
- If needed: cap at $15k, applied only after a signed order form, and only for accounts with (i) security questionnaire in progress and (ii) defined procurement timeline.

4) ROI justification
- For any discount/credit beyond hosted credits, we need a simple ROI justification template:
  - expected contract type (Dedicated vs Private)
  - est. ARR / commit
  - probability (best estimate)
  - timeline to signature
  - what we’re getting in exchange (MAP, referenceability, co-sell, etc.)

If you’re aligned, I’ll send a final “pilot credits policy” blurb for Sales + CS so everyone uses consistent language.

Laura

—
Laura Bennett
Finance, Redwood Inference



From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 22, 2025 at 10:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request

Laura — aligned on tightening this.

One nuance: for regulated buyers, getting through security review is the bottleneck. We need a small amount of “friction removal” to keep momentum once they ask for evidence + a short benchmark.

Can we treat the *hosted credits* as the standard and then allow Dedicated/Private exceptions only when:
- the account is on the ABM target list
- we have a scheduled security review + next-step date
- there is an exec sponsor identified on the buyer side

If yes, Ben can update the 1-pager and we can have Sales/SE use that language in outreach.

Camila

—
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference



From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 22, 2025 at 11:11 AM PT
Subject: Re: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request

+1 to Laura’s guardrails.

From Sales side, I’d like two additions so the field doesn’t improvise:

- A “what you can say” line for AEs:
  “We can sponsor a limited, time-boxed evaluation credit for qualified regulated workloads once we align on success criteria and a mutual action plan.”

- An “automatic no” list:
  - unlimited credits
  - credits without a deal record + owner
  - discounts before security review begins
  - anything that extends pilot past 8 weeks without a signed commercial path

Also: please keep approval turnaround fast (same-day) once we have the template filled out — these accounts move quickly when they move.

Steph

—
Stephanie Nguyen
NA Sales Leader, Redwood Inference



From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 22, 2025 at 12:03 PM PT
Subject: Re: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request

Steph — agreed.

We can do same-day approval if the request is complete. Where requests get stuck is missing deal value, missing timeline, or “we’ll figure it out later.”

Ben: I’ve attached a lightweight ROI justification template. If you can make it a required field in the pilot tracker (or at least required for Dedicated/Private exceptions), that solves 80% of the churn.

Final policy proposal (Finance-approved) for the ABM pilot:

A) Standard (no additional approval beyond AE + Sales leader)
- Hosted eval credits: up to $10,000 per account
- Expiry: 60 days
- Requirements: HubSpot deal link + named owner + success criteria + end date

B) Exception-based (requires VP Sales + Finance approval)
- Dedicated: choose one
  1) waive setup fee OR
  2) 5% discount for first 3 months
  Requirements: 12-month commit, >= $250k ARR equivalent, MAP with procurement milestones

- Private: up to $15,000 credits applied to first invoice after signature
  Requirements: security questionnaire in progress + defined procurement timeline + SE scoping complete

C) Absolute no
- Discounts/credits promised in writing before approval
- Extensions beyond 8 weeks without a commercial path
- Credits that can be used for non-pilot production traffic

If everyone is good with this, I’ll post a summary in the Sales channel and we can consider it “policy for the ABM pilot” only (not a blanket pricing change).

Laura

Attachment: Pilot_ROI_Justification_Template_v1.docx



From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 22, 2025 at 2:37 PM PT
Subject: Re: ABM pilot (regulated) — discount + credits approval request

Confirmed — we’ll adopt this as the pilot policy.

Next steps on my side:
- Update the guardrails 1-pager with your final language + the “absolute no” list
- Add the ROI template fields into the pilot tracker so Dedicated/Private exceptions can’t be submitted incomplete
- Coordinate with Isabelle on tagging credits in HubSpot so we can report pipeline influenced vs credits consumed

Laura — please go ahead and post the approved policy summary in Sales. I’ll link it from the ABM pilot brief.

Thanks all,
Ben

—
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing (ABM)
Redwood Inference
